home.impact: What {years} years of neighbors have done
home.saturdayText: Plant trees, pull tires out of the river or count mayflies. No experience needed; we bring the tools and the coffee.
home.monthlyText: $25 plants four trees. Monthly gifts let us plan a whole season ahead.
home.memberText: Members vote for the board, get the river report twice a year and paddle with us at member prices.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.description: Plant trees, clean up the river, test the water or paddle with us. Upcoming volunteer days on the Sallow River.
volunteer.heading: Come out on a Saturday
volunteer.lead: No experience needed. We bring gloves, tools, waders and coffee; you bring boots that can get muddy and a water bottle. Under-18s come with an adult.
volunteer.howTo: To sign up, use the button next to a date: it opens an email to {name}, who will write back with directions. Groups, schools and companies: write to us for a day of your own.
volunteer.empty: Nothing on the calendar right now. New dates are posted every season; write to {email} and we'll let you know.
volunteer.noMatch: No days match. Try another filter.

stories.title: Stories
stories.description: News and long reads from the Sallow River: dam removals, kingfishers, what students found in the water.
stories.heading: From the river

work.title: Our work
work.description: Streamside forests, dam removals, water testing with schools and river cleanups on the Sallow River and its creeks.
work.heading: Four ways to fix a river
work.lead: A river gets sick slowly: the trees along it go, a dam holds it back, trash and fertilizer wash in. We work on all of it at once, a mile at a time, with the people who live along the water.

about.office: The office is usually staffed on weekday mornings. On Saturdays, we're out on the river.

donate.title: Give
donate.description: Support {name}: a one-time or monthly gift plants trees, funds water testing and takes out old dams.
donate.heading: Every $6 plants a tree that will shade the creek for a hundred years
donate.lead: Most of our money comes from people who live along the river. It pays for seedlings, waders, water-testing kits and the heavy equipment that takes old dams out.
donate.anyAmount: Every dollar goes to the river.
donate.note: {name} is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN {ein}); your gift is tax-deductible as allowed by law. Membership starts at $25 a year.
